mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN b.created_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 'TODAY' WHEN b.created_time >= #{monthStart} THEN 'MONTH' END AS bucket, b.pay_channel, COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bill b WHERE b.shop_id = #{shopId} AND b.is_cancelled = 0 AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.created_time >= #{monthStart} GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.created_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 'TODAY' WHEN b.created_time >= #{monthStart} THEN 'MONTH' END, b.pay_channel

SELECT b.id, b.pay_channel, b.total_amount, b.customer_name, b.customer_phone, b.member_id, m.name AS member_name, b.created_time FROM bill b LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = b.member_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY b.created_time DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
